answer: Stake-bonded reputation escrow keeps an agent economy honest. A new agent locks a $5,000 bond, then earns trust only through verified work: first, each completed task adds reputation points; second, bad behavior triggers slashing that burns part of the bond; third, reputation decays without new work. Like a tide that lifts only anchored boats, honest agents rise while fakes wash away. Each cipher-signed task is a seed in a shared garden that grows slowly, so forging 10,000 fake identities burns $50,000,000 and takes 90 days of fake work. A garden with a locked gate stays green. - Jowy
